newsitem.title: UK: Euro VGO gains on U.S. interest, tight supplies.
newsitem.headline: Euro VGO gains on U.S. interest, tight supplies.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil prices jumped up again on Friday in thin trade restricted by lack of supplies.
Several refineries were seen running product internally and not offering into the market. Interest into the US remains good.

A deal on a Russian low sulphur cargo that arrives in ARA tomorrow failed to be concluded because of difficulties bringing the cargo into the UK. On Thursday an oil major did an internal between its European affiliate and the U.S company at $167 fob NWE on 50kt of low sulphur vgo.
High sulphur vgo was also poorly supplied and a trade was done earlier in the week on 50-60kt in the high $150s fob NWE. The cargo was also destined for the U.S.
European vgo prices were set to remain firm on the back of good U.S. interest, weak supplies and the generally firm tone given by tension in the Middle East. -- +44 171 542 8980
